task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First of all, pick up the keycard from the floor of the playroom. After that, make an effort to travel east. And then, unlock the hatch within the shower with the keycard. After you have unlocked the hatch, doublecheck that the hatch inside the shower is opened. After pulling open the hatch, go south. Next, open the gate in the bedroom. And then, venture south. Then, make absolutely sure that the portal is opened. Having opened the portal, try to go to the east. And then, make absolutely sure that the door in the dish-pit is opened. And then, head south. If you can manage that, venture east. Okay, and then, go east. After that, pick up the latchkey from the rack. And if you do that, you're the winner!
